summary: The customer called complaining about a total internet outage that disrupted their work and meeting schedule. The agent apologized, verified the account, and explained that an emergency maintenance on the main cable caused the area-wide outage. After the customer pressed for a specific timeline and compensation, the agent provided an estimated restoration time of one to one-and-a-half hours and offered 5 GB of free mobile data as compensation.

evidence.text: رح أضيفلك ٥ جيجابايت مجانية تضل صالحة لأسبوع كامل
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Add 5 GB of free mobile data valid for a week as compensation.

evidence.text: أعتذر منك جداً على التأخير وضغط الاتصالات يا أخي
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a polite, calm, and professional demeanor throughout the call despite the customer's frustration.

evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent provided a realistic ETA for the outage and offered tangible compensation (5 GB data) to help resolve the customer's immediate issue.
